initialExam.title: JAG Entry Scheme 2026
initialExam.description: Judge Advocate General Entry Scheme for law graduates to join the Indian Army as officers in the legal branch. JAG officers handle military law, courts martial, and legal affairs.
initialExam.eligibility: LLB degree (3-year or 5-year) with minimum 55% marks, enrolled with Bar Council
initialExam.qualifications: LLB from recognized university with 55% aggregate
initialExam.syllabus: No written exam. SSB Interview: OIR Test, PPDT, GTO Tasks, Psychology Tests, Personal Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Shortlisting based on CLAT/LLB marks. SSB Interview: 5 days.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Shortlisting → SSB Interview (5 days) → Medical Examination → Merit List
initialExam.jobRole: JAG Officer handling military law, courts martial, legal opinions in Indian Army
initialExam.careerGrowth: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → Lieutenant Colonel → Colonel → Brigadier (JAG Branch).
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. SSB 5. Medical
initialExam.perks: MSP, DA, Kit allowance, Free accommodation, Medical, CSD, Leave Travel
